items.rationale: 5>3 is TRUE but 2>4 is FALSE. AND needs every test to be TRUE, so the result is FALSE.
Only line A passes both tests: 12<20 and it is Active. Line B is at the reorder point, not below it. Line C is below its reorder point but is Discontinued. So 1 line needs a reorder.
AND is a function: its tests go inside brackets, separated by commas. F2 on its own is not a test. The word AND cannot sit between tests, and a single test ignores the sell-through rule.
40% > 40% is FALSE because > means strictly above. AND is then FALSE and IF returns Review. Use >= if a line that meets the target should count.
